In @higgsfield.ai Nano Banana 2:

Ultra-realistic cinematic detective scene generated from the reference image.
The subject must remain exactly the same as in the reference image. Preserve the identical pose, body position, facial expression, gaze direction, hand position holding the mug, and overall framing. Do not modify posture, composition, or subject placement.
The subject is wearing a tailored grey detective suit with a subtle fabric texture and a slightly relaxed fit. Underneath is a white shirt with a slightly loosened dark tie.
The wall in front of the subject is a full investigation board. It is densely covered with red strings connecting photographs, printed documents, maps, handwritten notes, newspaper clippings, and evidence images. The board should include real metal pins, naturally stretched strings, and multiple overlapping layers of materials to create a detailed investigative setup.
Outside the window the sky is completely overcast with heavy grey clouds. Cold, diffused daylight enters the room. The exterior environment appears muted and desaturated.
Steam is visibly rising from the coffee mug, forming soft volumetric vapor with realistic heat distortion.
In front of the subject there is a wooden detective desk containing scattered papers, folders, documents, and a desk lamp. The lamp emits a warm, focused light that creates a subtle glow on the surrounding surfaces.
Lighting should create cinematic contrast between the cool ambient light coming from the window and the warm illumination from the desk lamp. Use soft shadows, controlled highlights, and strong depth to enhance the dramatic atmosphere.
Color grading should follow a cold-temperature palette with white and blue tones. The image should have a moody crime-series aesthetic, with cold blue and teal shadows, slightly desaturated colors overall, strong contrast, and subtle warm highlights from practical lights. The overall style should resemble modern high-end noir detective television dramas.
